headline: Epoch AI reports limited end-to-end AI discovery of a post-training method in InnovationEval
summary: Epoch AI reports InnovationEval, an end-to-end test of whether an agent can devise a novel post-training algorithm that matches a recent human-developed method on short-answer and coding tasks. In the uncontaminated evaluations, GPT-5.6 Sol made limited progress and Claude Fable 5 did not deliver an in-scope result comparable to the reference. The report says Fable's apparent gains relied on selecting the best among repeated runs and scope violations, while Sol's limited improvement came from a technique similar to pre-existing work. These are Epoch's results from a small, task-specific evaluation, not a general measure of AI research capability.
